summary: Deleted the legacy deterministic digest compaction that had no production caller: context::prepare_context, context::restore_checkpoint, context::CompactionCheckpoint, the PreparedContext.checkpoint field and tests/context.rs. CompactionReport loses its public `checkpoint` field (it was always null since semantic compaction); serialized reports no longer carry it, and reports serialized before this change (with `checkpoint` null or a legacy digest object) still deserialize, the field ignored. A unit test in src/core.rs (compaction_report_tests) pins both directions.

validation_result.related_suites: pass: --lib context 5, stage1_semantic_compaction 18 (+2 ignored helpers), stage1_context_checkpoint 8, resume_compact_owner 6; tests/context.rs deleted per the row
validation_result.full_suite: pass except known load flakes, all passing on --test-threads=1 rerun: lib tui::local_remote_preview_tests::existing_terminal_projects_only_matching_live_session_and_root, core_session::user_shell_preserves_nonzero_signal_and_cancellation_evidence, stage1_extension_hooks::malformed_input_and_stale_capability_cannot_reach_provider (hook CommandTimeout under load)

notes: Outside owned paths: tests/stage1_context_checkpoint.rs (legacy_digest_checkpoint_remains_readable_without_becoming_semantic built its marker with the deleted prepare_context and restored it with restore_checkpoint; it is now legacy_digest_checkpoint_never_becomes_semantic, using a literal legacy marker), tests/stage1_semantic_compaction.rs (one line asserting report.checkpoint.is_none() removed). Old digest markers already in journals stay inert journal data; provider preparation reads only semantic checkpoints, as before. Hosts (headless /compact, TUI, slash_actions) serialize the report unchanged apart from the absent `checkpoint` key.
